Her figure is divided into 5 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 50% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 4 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 19%, 49%, 78% and 91% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 5 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries Mondrian style grid of thick black lines with flat blocks of primary red, yellow and blue and white. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Her skin shows high gloss body oil, heavily oiled glistening skin, wet-look shine.
